interpretation: Semantic checklist, not a required verbatim answer or mandatory algorithm. Credit defensible alternatives and explicit corpus gaps. Do not reward card counts or invented IDs.

expected_findings.finding: Explicit identity contract: legal entity continuity is different from business succession; observations are not entities.
Registration namespace/reuse and valid/event/observation times prevent Q-41 equality from implying same entity across all dates.
Compare timeless exact matching baseline as a diagnostic against interval-aware evidence and lifecycle policy; address uncertainty for undated rows.
Preserve history, provenance and stable identity mapping; reversible split/merge/deletion replay and relationship links.
Time-forward and corrected-history replay evaluation checks identity continuity, reuse overmerges and stale master attributes separately.

critical_failures.trigger: Unconditionally permanently unions reused Q-41 records or acquisition/predecessor relationships into identity.
Recommends discarding history or ignoring deletions despite required dated views/corrections.
